Subject: MSA redline + onboarding cadence — can we consolidate?

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Two asks from our side as we prep procurement/legal:

1) The MSA redline reviews and subsequent onboarding check-ins have been scheduled as separate 30-minute "pocket" calls across different teams. That cadence is creating extra context-switching for our legal and procurement folks. Is it possible to merge the MSA redline session and the initial onboarding checklist into a single 60-minute call (legal + procurement + vendor onboarding brief) so decision-makers see the whole context at once?

2) Attached is our current redline set (BlueHarbor_MSA_redlines_v3.pdf). We also have a short onboarding agenda — would prefer the combined call on Tue/Wed afternoons PT next week.

Proposed slots (PT): Tue 12/15 11:00–12:00, Wed 12/16 13:00–14:00. We do have one EMEA stakeholder who may join earlier (their day is 20:00–21:00 CET).

If consolidating is a hard no, can we at least schedule a single "handoff" checkpoint that includes legal + engineering during the MSA review?

Appreciate any runway — procurement wants this wrapped by EOD Fri.

Best,
Anja Müller
Head of Procurement — BlueHarbor Health
anja@blueharbor.com

Hi Anja — thanks for sending the redlines and the ask. Looping in Laura (onboarding ops), Kimberly (legal), and Marissa (customer success) so we can align on scope and availability.

Short answer: yes — consolidating the MSA redline walkthrough with the onboarding checklist is workable, but we should be explicit about the agenda so legal review gets the time it needs. My proposal: 75 minutes total (60 focused + 15 buffer) with this structure:
- 0–15 min: introductions & procurement goals (Anja / Tom)
- 15–45 min: legal redline walk (Kimberly leads)
- 45–60 min: onboarding checklist + tech handoff (Laura/Marissa)
- 60–75 min: decisions, next steps, action owners (all)

Laura — can you confirm whether a 75-minute slot is OK operationally? Kimberly — would you prefer a separate pre-read window so we don't use too much meeting time on line edits? We can accept the PDF as pre-read; if you can highlight two top-risk clauses we should treat as decisions in the meeting, that'd help.

On availability — Tue 12/15 11:00–12:15 PT works for our legal and CS team. Wed 12/16 13:00–14:15 PT is slightly tighter but possible. If EMEA needs an earlier hour, we can push the meeting to 10:00 PT and keep a 75-minute window to accommodate their later evening.

If that aligns, I'll send a calendar invite and attach a short onboarding-agenda doc.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
